definitions.explanation: A sleeveless women's top with thin shoulder straps, worn as underwear or, in summer, on its own or layered under a jacket or cardigan.

examples.japanese: キャミソール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧キャミソール⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: In summer I get by in just a camisole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦ブラウス→ブラウス：04517_burausu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧キャミソール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{透|す}けなくて→透ける：04568_sukeru⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧だ。
examples.english: Wearing a camisole under a thin blouse puts your mind at rest that it won't be see-through.

notes:
From English "camisole"; shortened to キャミ in casual speech. Worn with ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- キャミソール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a camisole
- キャミソール⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: just a camisole
- キャミソール⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧: a slip dress

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦タンクトップ→タンクトップ：28939_tankutoppu⟧: tank top — wider straps, also worn by men
